notes: v1.6.1 — Two fixes for Guard locks that cross 5 PM New York. A timed disconnect that ends after 5 PM New York now reconnects NinjaTrader by itself when it ends, as at any other time of day; a disconnect that runs to the 5 PM close (rest of day) still leaves NinjaTrader offline until you reconnect. A timed pause that runs past 5 PM New York is shown as a pause with its end time, not "locked for the day". Closing or reducing a position is never blocked.
